description: Source code for DeepSeekChatConfig class that extends OpenAIGPTConfig to support DeepSeek-specific parameters and URL handling for chat completions, including parameter mapping, message transformation, and API URL construction.

classes.name: DeepSeekChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for DeepSeek chat models, supporting parameter mapping, message transformation, and URL generation tailored for DeepSeek's API.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameters, extended with 'thinking' and 'reasoning_effort'.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps standard OpenAI parameters to DeepSeek-specific parameters, handling 'thinking' and 'reasoning_effort'.

methods.name: _transform_messages
methods.description: Transforms message list to string format if needed, supporting both sync and async calls.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and API key, using secrets if not provided.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for chat completions, appending '/chat/completions' if missing.
